scope: Agent visual review of actual native setup/installed captures, supported by separate guest tasks and file-byte evidence. Not a participant usability study or full accessibility qualification.
findings: Clarity: the actual selected disk, capacity, account, app count, appearance, size and guide are listed before writes. Replacement has a separate visible erase checkbox and disabled Install until consent.
Convenience: ordinary choices keep Back/Next visible; compact 800x600 keeps the real app, account and appearance controls while omitting decorative previews.
User friendliness: app tiles combine recognizable original icons, names and explicit checkmarks; a real minimal install retains required Settings management and returns with Back.
Graphical quality: native semantic fonts, shared palettes, measured labels, aligned full-width rows and separate footer controls remain legible at actual 150% and physical 4K/200%.

Readability: reviewed essential labels and hit targets do not overlap; failure clearly states installation is incomplete, offers Back/Details and does not show success. Recovery uses four named steps.
The themed first-start text and base actions are readable; its boundary over a similarly dark Files surface needs stronger contrast in the ordered M12.16 accessibility stage.

carry_forward.observation: Strengthen first-start card boundary contrast; qualify complete keyboard/focus/scale/cursor routes and accessibility themes.
Optimize and measure the software renderer without broad FPS or GPU-3D claims.
Run frozen final controller/original-app and retained BIOS/AHCI concurrency/site-sharing qualification.
